prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1265; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was stopped at a red signal in the left lane when the rear of the vehicle was struck by a sedan operated by Driver 2. Responding officers observed significant rear-end crush damage to Driver 1's vehicle, consistent with the impact described by both drivers. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred just as he described at the scene, and his account matched the physical evidence. Two independent witnesses on the adjacent corner confirmed the sequence of events, and scene photographs taken by officers recorded the damage to both vehicles. Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel when officers arrived, and a Passenger in the front seat was also confirmed present by witnesses and by the officers' own observation. Driver 1 reported a head injury and complained of concussion symptoms, including headache and dizziness, which fit the force of a collision of this nature. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to officers or reported by any party. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the vehicle's policy. Both vehicles were towed from the scene, and Driver 1 was transported for medical evaluation.
